About

Chai Live · Version 14

Live video, chat, gifts and friends — made for everyone.

Privacy Policy

Chai Live stores your account name, a scrambled password, your coins, beans, gifts, followers and level on the app server so your account survives restarts. Your location (city and country) is saved ONLY when you turn Location on yourself, and it is hidden again when you turn it off. A private account hides your location and your followers / following lists from other users. Blocked users can't send you chat messages or join your live. Reports are used only to keep the app safe. Your live video is never recorded or saved on the server.

Privacy

Hide location

Hide your online status

After turning this on, your online information will not be displayed.

Hide your recent active time

After turning this on, others won't see your recent active time.

Do not disturb from strangers

After turning this on, you will not be disturbed by any strangers' messages except the official account.
